description_expanded: OverviewWatersound West-4 Bikes- Community Pool/Heated Seasonally- Private Beach-3 Minute Bike Ride- `Half Moon Hideaway`The Space QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: 4 Adult Bikes Provided – Explore 30A with ease Private, Gated Community – Enjoy peace & tranquility Private Beach Access – Over the scenic boardwalk Zero-Entry Community Pool – With cabanas, grill area & fireplace Seasonal Pool Heating – For year-round relaxation Gas Grill & Outdoor Seating – Perfect for cookouts 2 Parking Spaces – Additional parking is guest's responsibility Flat-Screen TVs in Every Room – Entertainment for all Professionally Managed, 24/7 Service – Hassle-free vacationWelcome to Half Moon HideawayWelcome to “Half Moon Hideaway” your dream vacation home located in beautiful Watersound West Beach – a private, gated community on the gulf side of 30A!Newly listed, this stunning 3 bedroom, 3 ½ bath home is the perfect destination for families or groups looking to relax and unwind on the sugar white sand of Florida’s Emerald Coast beaches.Styled with optimal comfort in mind this vacation home offers 3 king bedrooms with accommodations for 10 guests. Each spacious king bedroom presents en suite baths with double vanities and plenty of closet space. The home interior features high-end finishes and modern coastal furnishings, making “Half Moon Hideaway” the ultimate oasis for your beach vacation.The main floor includes a master, a beautifully decorated open living space with comfortable seating and dining options, and a well-appointed kitchen complete with all the cookware and dinnerware to prepare your favorite meals or beach snacks! Adjacent to the kitchen is a dry bar with wine cooler, powder room, and laundry room.Just beyond the living room, you are welcomed into the screened porch overlooking the boardwalk. What a perfect setting for sipping your morning coffee, or enjoying an evening cocktail, complemented with relaxed seating and a dining area. This is where beach memories are made! The large exterior deck features a gas grill and enclosed outdoor shower.Filled with natural light, the second floor boasts a spacious master, a large guest bedroom with two closets, and bunk beds. A private, second living space with television separates the bedroom suites, providing an ideal gathering area for children and teenagers to hang out, or simply used as a quiet space to relax!The garage offers an additional refrigerator, along with a generous drop-area dedicated to all your beach gear.Close to everything, yet secluded from crowds, Watersound West Beach is a charming community, an oasis filled with tranquil foot paths and meandering boardwalks throughout! This vacation rental is a leisurely walk or a short bike ride away from some of the most stunning beaches in the area.Additionally, this home comes equipped with 4 bicycles making it easy to explore the beautiful surrounding area along 30A. “Half Moon Hideaway” is located minutes away from lively food, shopping, and fun!!Whether you are looking for a peaceful retreat or an action-packed adventure, this home has everything you need for an unforgettable vacation. Book now and start planning your dream beach getaway!House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**** Garage is available for storage**** Bicycles are not allowed on boardwalks at any time *EXCEPT* near the pool and through the Deer Lake State Park beach access where railings are present. Follow the signs for guidance. ****Watersound West HOA does not permit golf carts****Watersound West does not provide access to Watersound Beach Club**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (10)1st floor - Master - King with en suite bath2nd floor - Master - King with en suite bath2nd floor - Guest - King with shared bath2nd floor - Bunk Area (2 Twins)2nd floor - Den with sofa sleeperShow less
